figurative_meaning_en: In a derogatory sense, a bad notion or flaw
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজে ছিরি আছে, ভালো হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: There is a flaw in his speech.
This work has a blemish; it won't turn out well.
note: Often used to point out imperfections in speech or actions in everyday Bengali discourse.
